requiredActions: Separate law from assurance; identify revision and verification vs supplemental fraud role

rules.trigger: No questions or signer lacks SSN/ITIN
requiredActions: Distinguish generation, answers, lockout, capture and account error
Check U.S.-address history and configured eligibility

requiredActions: Use transaction-date law
Identify personal knowledge, qualifying witness or distinct listed-method combination
For certificate/PIV establish signer credential/access; for adopted method name authority/version

Notary signing certificate proves signer credential
Current KBA item cures earlier method automatically

requiredActions: Use dedicated threshold as attributed instructions and disclose scoring conflict
Notify sender; no manual unlock promise
Separate provider once-only claim from statutory reuse ceiling
Publish no quiz answers or identity records
mustNotConclude: Any one wrong answer always fails

requiredActions: Separate ID support, method completion, required record and recipient/output acceptance
Keep agent products separate from notarization
Do not manufacture personal knowledge
Attribute product-specific credit-history wording
Keep public/proprietary/non-credit categories separate
Leave supplier and FCRA classification unresolved without evidence
mustNotConclude: Every KBA is ordinary credit report
No consent screen proves no credit input or duties
Proof uses LexisNexis because that vendor sells KBA

requiredActions: Use published intake for document/location/ID/destination/recipient review
Describe current offering conditionally
Separate additional service possibilities from existing offerings
mustNotConclude: Guarantee pass, deadline, country coverage or recipient acceptance
